name: Landfall
description: Lantern section's transport came down in the fields short of Ashgate with Dr Vey's data on board. Find the flight recorder in the spilled cargo, silence the town and keep a beacon lit until the last bird out finds you.
briefing: Three weeks ago Halden Agritech sprayed a blight called BRIAR on the fields round Ashgate to kill crop pests. The barley went to the food depot, the food went to the town, and the town stopped being a town.
The army has drawn a line round it: the Rotline. You are Lantern section, and your transport just fell out of the sky inside it. Kestrel got out. The flight crew did not.

The flight recorder holds the only copy of Dr Vey's field data: what BRIAR is, and maybe how to stop it. It was thrown clear with the cargo. Find it, shut up the Screamers calling the town onto you, get through the checkpoint and light the beacon in the hospital car park. The last bird out of Ashgate lifts in twelve minutes.
debrief: Recorder's aboard and so are you. Dr Vey is going to want to meet the people who carried her life's work through a burning town.

objectives.label: Search the spilled cargo for the flight recorder

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Lantern, Okafor. You are inside the Rotline with no ride. The recorder was thrown clear with the cargo: it is in one of those crates. Go through them, fast. They can smell the fuel.
radio.done: Recorder secured. The farm road gate is open: up the high street.

objectives.label: Kill the three Screamers calling the town down on you

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren, on the water tower. Three Screamers on the high street, and every scream brings another street's worth. I've marked them. Shut them up.
radio.done: That's the last one. Listen to that: quiet. Get to the checkpoint.

objectives.label: Hold the checkpoint while the soldiers inside cut the gate

radio.speaker: Pte Shah
radio.start: This is Shah, inside the checkpoint. The gate motor's dead, we're cutting the chain by hand. Thirty seconds. Keep them off our backs!
radio.done: It's through! The square's yours. Ours too, I suppose.

objectives.label: Keep the landing beacon lit until Kestrel finds it

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. I got a new bird and I can't see a thing in that smoke. There's a beacon on the hospital car park: switch it on and keep it on. And something big just walked out of the town hall.
radio.done: I see your beacon. Coming in.

objectives.label: Get on the bird

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Wheels down! Lantern, everybody on, now!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 150
Optional: burn the nests in the square

notes.title: Cotter's farm diary
notes.text: Halden men back with the sprayers again, white suits, said the barley would come up clean of weevil for ten years. It came up clean all right. The cows won't go near the north field and the dog dug something up out of it that was still moving. Sold the crop to the depot Tuesday. Good price.

notes.title: Checkpoint log, day 6
notes.text: Orders changed again. Nobody leaves without a Halden pass. Nobody has a Halden pass. A woman brought her boy to the gate, said he was only feverish. Sergeant told me to stop counting the ones we turn back. I have stopped counting. I have not stopped hearing them.

notes.title: A letter from the bank
notes.text: Elaine. The army took the vault keys on Monday and filled it with Halden's boxes: sample cases, they said, too precious to move. Then they bricked the door up and left. I have been sleeping above them. Something in there scratches at night. If the bird comes, take it. Don't wait for me.

name: Rail Yard
description: The last train east is waiting on Ashgate's freight yard, and the switch keys are on a dead man. Take them off the stationmaster, walk the shunter through the stacks and keep the points motor running while four hundred people cross.
briefing: Four hundred people are sitting in a train on the far side of Ashgate's freight yard, engine running, going nowhere: the points are locked and the signalman is dead.
The switch keys are on the stationmaster's belt. He turned in his office. The yard is three sections behind gates: the platform, the container stacks, the signal yard. Each gate locks behind you.

A dead wagon blocks the junction. The yard shunter can push it clear, but it stops for nothing living or dead: keep the dead off it all the way through the stacks. Then keep the points motor alive while the train crawls over. The fog is thick: listen for them.
debrief: The last train is over the junction and out of the Rotline. Four hundred and twelve people. Hollis says she'll name her next engine after you.

objectives.label: Put down the stationmaster: the switch keys are on him

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Lantern, this is Hollis, driving the train you can't see in this soup. The switch keys are on the stationmaster's belt, and the stationmaster is one of them now. He was in his office. He won't have gone far.
radio.done: Keys! The yard gate's open: my shunter's waiting in the stacks.

objectives.label: Ride with the shunter through the stacks

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: The shunter pushes the dead wagon off the junction or nobody goes anywhere. It creeps while you walk with it and it stops dead the moment one of them is on it. Keep it clean!
radio.done: It's through to the signal yard. Good shooting.

objectives.label: Keep the points motor running while the train crosses

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Points are over and I'm rolling. That motor holds the blades while I cross: sixty seconds, and if it stops my front bogie goes off the rails with four hundred people behind it!
radio.done: Over! Clear of the junction. The road gate is open.

objectives.label: Get on the trucks

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Trucks are on the convoy road between the warehouses. Everyone on.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 150
Optional: burn the nests in the stacks

notes.title: Consignment ledger
notes.text: Halden Agritech, 40 crates "seed stock", to Ashgate Food Depot, priority, no inspection by order of the Ministry. Halden Agritech, 12 crates, return to Harrow, sealed, ARMED ESCORT. Halden Agritech, 1 tanker, contents not declared. I asked what was in the tanker. The escort asked how my wife was.

notes.title: Note on the signal panel
notes.text: If you are reading this I did not make it back from the yard. Points are locked with the keys, not the panel, so the trains can't be turned back to the city. Halden's idea. Keys are with Pell. Whatever you do, get the people out on the east line. Do not let them send the train to Harrow.

notes.title: Scratched into the lamp room wall
notes.text: They said the rot is in the barley. Then why is it in the rats. Then why is it in the water. Then why is it in me. Day 4 in here. Bricked myself in with the lamps. They light up when the dead walk past.

name: Blackout
description: Ashgate's power plant has gone dark, and with it the wards in Harrow where Dr Vey's first patients are holding on. Break the night guard out, restart the yard, patch the transformer and run before it all burns.
briefing: Dr Vey has eleven patients in Harrow General who caught BRIAR and did not turn: the first ones her serum kept alive. They are on machines. The machines run off Ashgate's power plant, and the plant has gone dark.

There are no lights inside. Use your weapon lights. The night guard bricked herself into the guard post with the fence keys; get her out. Each generator you restart brings floodlights back on: the yard gets brighter as you work, and so does what is hunting you in it.

The transformer has been chewed half to bits: patch it, then keep it standing while it charges. Its field kills every battery near it, so your kit will be dead while it does. Bielak says the turbines may not take the load. Thirteen minutes on the hospital's batteries.
debrief: Harrow General's wards just came back on. Eleven patients, eleven heartbeats. Ashgate's power plant is a bonfire. Dr Vey cried on the radio. Don't tell her I told you.

objectives.label: Break the night guard out of the guard post

radio.speaker: Ola
radio.start: Is someone there? It's Ola, the night guard. I bricked myself into the guard post with the fence keys. You'll have to knock the wall down. Please knock the wall down.
radio.done: The fence is open. I'm staying by the gate, I'm not going in there.

objectives.label: Restart the three generators in the yard

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Bielak, shift engineer, the last one, on the turbine hall roof. Three generators in the transformer yard. Every one you start lights a floodlight and wakes a turret.
radio.done: All three running. Look at that: you can see the yard.

objectives.label: Patch up the transformer before it takes the load

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: The transformer's been chewed half to bits. Hold E on it and patch it up: it won't take the load like that, and they know it's the thing that matters.
radio.done: It'll hold. I think. Bringing it up.

objectives.label: Keep the transformer standing while it charges

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: It's charging, and the field off it will fry anything with a battery: your kit is dead until it's done. Guns only. Fifty seconds!
radio.done: It's live! Harrow has power. Oh no. Oh no, the turbines.

objectives.label: Out past the cooling towers before the fire catches you

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: The load's run the turbines away and the yard's going up behind you! Through the turbine hall and out past the cooling towers. Don't stop for anything!

objectives.label: Optional: thin them out
Optional: burn the nests in the yard

notes.title: Shift log, night 9
notes.text: Cooling water intake clogged again. Pulled it up: not weed. White threads, warm to the touch, growing back as you cut them. Halden's contract says the plant feeds their Harrow site first, always, even over the hospital. Day shift didn't come in. Night shift is me.

notes.title: Memo pinned in the control room
notes.text: PRIORITY SUPPLY. In any shortfall, load shedding is to follow the Halden schedule: Halden Harrow site, Ministry, Harrow General, residential. This instruction supersedes local emergency procedure. Questions to Minister Marlowe's office.

notes.title: Under the guard's chair
notes.text: Bricked the door myself. Got biscuits, water, the radio. Heard the army say they're drawing a line round the whole district and calling it the Rotline. Funny name for a cemetery. If the lights come on again, someone came for us. Leave the biscuits.

name: Holdouts
description: Elm Close barricaded itself in when Ashgate fell, and somewhere in it is Mila Pryce, nine, bitten three weeks ago and still herself. Hold the gate, walk the families out, find the minibus keys and walk the minibus through the park.

objectives.label: Hold the barricade while the residents winch the gate

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Lantern, Okafor. The residents of Elm Close are winching their gate open for you by hand, and the main road is crawling. Stand at the barricade and keep them off the winch.
radio.done: Gate's open. Somebody in there still has a winch, and a sense of humour.

objectives.label: Walk both families to the far barricade

radio.speaker: Mila
radio.start: Are you the soldiers? Mum says to stay behind you. The Abaras are across the road. The tall man in the garden is still there. He doesn't move but he watches.
radio.done: We're at the gate. Mum's crying but the good kind.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute in the schoolyard

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: The tall man from her drawing is a Brute, and it's standing on the school drive by the minibus. It has to go.
radio.done: It's down. Now, who has the keys?

objectives.label: Search the cars on the school drive for the minibus keys

radio.speaker: J. Abara
radio.start: The driver left the keys in her car, she always did. Which car? I don't know which car! One of the ones on the drive. Hurry!
radio.done: Got them! Engine's running.

objectives.label: Walk the minibus out through the park

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Hollis again, I'm driving the minibus. Families aboard. I go at walking pace through the park and only while you're round me, and slower with them clawing at it. Keep them off my bonnet!

objectives.label: Optional: crack the gun shop's safe
Optional: burn the nests in the back gardens

briefing: Elm Close held: the residents rolled containers across both ends of the street and waited. Two families are still in there. Their radio went quiet this morning.
One of them has a girl called Mila Pryce. She was bitten in the school playground three weeks ago, and she never turned. Dr Vey says Mila's blood may be the whole cure. Okafor says bring everyone.

Hold the barricade while the residents winch their gate, walk both families through to the school, find the minibus keys (the driver left them in one of the cars on the drive) and walk the minibus out through the park. It is slow, it is loud, and every dead thing in the Close will want it. The roads close in fifteen minutes.
debrief: Minibus is rolling with both families on it. Mila asked if the soldiers are the ones from her drawing. Elm Close held out. So did you.

notes.title: Residents' meeting, minutes
notes.text: Agreed: containers across both ends (Mr Okoye's crane). Agreed: no one leaves alone. Agreed: Mila Pryce stays with us whatever the army says about the bitten. Not agreed: what to do about the Hendersons' house. Mr Henderson bricked his own front door up on Thursday and has not answered since.

notes.title: A child's drawing
notes.text: A house, a sun, Mum, Dad, me. The tall man in the garden. He doesn't come in. Soldiers coming down the road with lights on their guns. (In crayon, underneath:) They will come. Mrs Fry said.

notes.title: Note on the kitchen table
notes.text: I saw what the bitten do. I am not going to do it in front of anyone. Ammunition in the cupboard, for whoever opens this house. Tell the Pryces I'm sorry I said what I said about their girl. She's braver than the lot of us.

name: Breakout
description: The last column out of Ashgate is loading at the army's motor pool with Mila, Dr Vey and every survivor on board. Hold the ring, get the last truck running, take back the loading bays and walk it out of the north gate.

objectives.label: Hold the sandbag ring while the column loads

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Briggs, motor pool. Column's loading. Hold the ring in the middle and draw them onto you, not onto my trucks.
radio.done: Most of them are out. Not the last one.

objectives.label: Get the last truck running

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: The last truck is the one with Mila and the doctor on it, and they've had the engine half out of it. Hold E on it and fix it while they go for it!
radio.done: She's running. Just about.

objectives.label: Take back the loading bays

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: They're into the loading bays: the sheds, the workshop and the fuel store. Take each one back and stand in it till my lads have grabbed what we need. Screamers in this lot: kill them first!
radio.done: Bays are ours. Everything's on the truck.

objectives.label: Put down the Brutes

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Two Brutes through the south fence, heading for the truck!
radio.done: Both down. I did not think that was possible. North gate's open!

objectives.label: Walk the last truck out of the north gate

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: She won't go faster than a walk, and she stops dead if one of them gets hold of her. Keep her clean all the way through the north gate!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 250
Optional: start the generators that wake the turrets

briefing: This is the end of Ashgate. Every survivor the Rotline found is in the motor pool, loading onto trucks: the train people, the Elm Close families, Dr Vey and her data, Mila Pryce.

The engines are pulling in everything for miles. Hold the sandbag ring in the middle of the yard while the column loads. The last truck has had its engine half out: it needs mending under fire, and what it carries is in the loading bays. Brutes have been seen at the south fence; the turrets wake if anyone starts their generators.
The last truck goes out with you walking beside it, through the north gate, and the Rotline pulls back to Harrow. Fourteen minutes. After that, the order is to burn the town.
debrief: The last truck is clear and the motor pool is theirs now. Ashgate is burning behind you. The Rotline is Harrow's problem now. So are you.

notes.title: Requisition, stamped DENIED
notes.text: Request: 400 litres diesel, 12 trucks, medical kit for 300 civilians. Denied: fuel and vehicles are reserved for Halden Agritech evacuation (Ministry order 14). Briggs' note in the margin: we are taking them anyway. Court-martial me in Harrow.

notes.title: An unsent letter
notes.text: Mum. They're calling it the Rotline like it's a thing on a map. It's us. It's twenty of us and some fences. A little girl came in today that got bitten and she's fine, she's eating crisps. The doctor lady looked at her like she was Christmas.

notes.title: Orders, in the quartermaster's bunker
notes.text: In the event the Rotline cannot be held at Ashgate, all Halden Agritech material is to be destroyed in place and the town denied to the infection by fire. Civilian evacuation is not to delay this order. Signed, E. Marlowe.

name: Airlift
description: Kestrel brought Mila's blood samples to Harrow airfield and both ramps jammed open on landing. Hold the bay, load the cold boxes, clear the runway of a Bolter pack and get the ramps shut.
briefing: Harrow, the city past the Rotline. Kestrel's transport put down on the airfield with a cold box full of Mila Pryce's blood, bound for Dr Vey's lab. Both ramps jammed open on landing.
Every dead thing for miles heard it land. Hold the cargo bay while the crew works, then carry the three cold boxes waiting in the hangar aboard, one at a time.
A pack of Bolters is running the runway where Kestrel has to roll: hunt them down. The ramps close on hydraulics between them; keep those running. The jumpseat room opens once the ramps are up.
debrief: Wheels up with the samples aboard. Dr Vey has her blood. She says give her a week. She says it like a prayer.

objectives.label: Hold the cargo bay

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. Both ramps jammed open on landing and every dead thing for miles heard us come down. Hold the bay while my crew works!
radio.done: Ramps are freed. Side bays are open.

objectives.label: Load the three cold boxes from the hangar

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey, from Harrow General. The cold boxes with Mila's blood came in on the first flight and they're sitting in the hangar. Three of them. Carry them aboard, one at a time, and please don't drop them.
radio.done: Three boxes aboard. Thank you. Thank you.

objectives.label: Kill the Bolter pack on the runway

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren, in the tower. A Bolter pack is running the runway, right where Kestrel has to roll. Fast ones, and tough. I've marked them.
radio.done: Runway's clear.

objectives.label: Keep the ramp hydraulics running while the ramps close

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Hydraulics are between the ramps and they're going for them. Sixty seconds and we're sealed!
radio.done: Ramps are up. Jumpseat room's open, there's a med kit in there.

objectives.label: Everyone aboard

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Engines are spinning up. Nose up in forty: get in the bay!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200

notes.title: Tower log
notes.text: All civilian traffic suspended. Halden Agritech charter cleared to land and depart at any time, no manifest. Third Halden flight today. Something in the cargo hold of the second one was banging. Ground crew refused to unload it. Bricked ourselves in on the ground floor.

notes.title: Grease pencil on the hangar door
notes.text: Ramp hydraulics on the transports are rubbish, always were. If you're stuck: ground power unit first, then the pumps, then pray. Gone home to my kids. If I have a home.

notes.title: A boarding card
notes.text: Halden Agritech staff evacuation, flight H-3, Gate 2. On the back, in pen: they took the scientists and left the cleaners. I cleaned the lab. I know what was in it.

name: Hive
description: The supermarket on Harrow's ring road took the last delivery from Ashgate's food depot. Now it breathes. Burn its pods, cut samples off its growths and blow up the thing growing in the loading yard before it seeds the city.
briefing: The supermarket on Harrow's ring road took the last lorry of barley flour out of Ashgate's food depot. It went quiet a week ago. Now it breathes.
Dr Vey calls it a hive: the rot has learned to build. Pods in the car park that burst when they die, nests in the aisles, and in the loading yard an egg the size of a van, with a brood round it.
Dr Vey wants samples from the aisles before anything burns. Then plant a charge under the egg, keep them off it while the fuse burns, and be well clear when it goes.
debrief: The hive is ash and the ring road is quiet. Dr Vey has her samples and wants one of whatever hatched. Okafor said no. Okafor said it twice.

objectives.label: Burn the pods in the car park

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Pods all over the car park, and they burst when they go: whatever is in them comes out angry. Burn them all, then we'll get the doors open.
radio.done: Car park's clear. The doors are giving way.

objectives.label: Cut samples off the growths in the aisles

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey. Before anything burns: the growths in the aisles are the rot learning to build, and I need to know how. Cut me four samples. The nests will fight you for them.
radio.done: Four samples. The loading doors are open.

objectives.label: Plant a charge under the egg and get clear

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: That egg is the size of a van and the brood round it is feeding it. Plant a charge under it, keep them off the charge for forty seconds, and be out of the red when it goes.
radio.done: That's the brood gone. Something's still moving in the shell.

objectives.label: Kill what crawls out of the egg

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: It's out! Half-cooked and furious. Put it down!
radio.done: It's dead. Van's on its way.

objectives.label: Out through the yard gate

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Van's at the yard gate. Everyone on!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200
Optional: burn the nests among the aisles

notes.title: Delivery note
notes.text: Barley flour, 2 pallets. Supplier: Halden Agritech trial fields. Price: nil (promotional). Note from the driver: they paid me double to bring it and not ask. Store manager signed for it. I didn't look back.

notes.title: An email, printed
notes.text: To head office. Staff are reporting a smell from the loading yard, sweet, like bread. Two of the night crew have not come back from the cold store. Please advise. (Handwritten:) No reply. Sealing the cold store. God help me.

notes.title: In the cold store
notes.text: Pete and me. Doors won't open from in here. Something is growing on the ceiling and it's warm. It's not cold in here any more. It's never cold any more.

name: Lifeline
description: Harrow General is losing power again, and on its top ward Dr Vey's eleven patients are in remission. The building is dark. Clear the atrium, gather the files, bring the nurse down, mend the oxygen and throw the breaker.
briefing: Harrow General: the hospital Blackout kept alive. Its doors still keep the dead out, but the Halden supply contract has cut its power again, and the backup batteries won't last.

It is dark inside. Your weapon lights are all you have until the breaker is thrown. Four corridors off the atrium open one at a time as you work: the files in the north wards, a nurse holed up in the east ward, the oxygen plant in the south wing, the breaker in the north-east.
The last team in didn't make it past the atrium. Their kit is still on the floor. Somewhere in this building is the file on patient zero.
debrief: Lights are on in Harrow General and every patient made it. In the patient zero file is one word Dr Vey had never seen: LANTERN. Marlowe's project, not hers.

objectives.label: Clear the atrium

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey, on the top ward. They're coming out of the walls in the atrium. Clear it and the north corridor opens. Keep your lights on.
radio.done: Corridor Alpha's open, north side.

objectives.label: Collect the BRIAR patients' files from the north wards

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Every BRIAR patient they ever admitted has a paper file, and Halden took the computers. Pick up four. Something in them made Marlowe nervous.
radio.done: Four files. Bravo's open, east side.

objectives.label: Bring the night nurse down from the east ward

radio.speaker: Sr Malik
radio.start: Sister Malik, east ward. I've been barricaded in the sluice room for two days with a mop. I can walk. I can't fight. Come and get me.
radio.done: She's with us. Charlie's open, south side.

objectives.label: Mend the oxygen plant in the south wing

radio.speaker: Sr Malik
radio.start: The oxygen plant is down the long corridor. If it goes, the ward goes with it. Hold E on it and patch the lines while they try to tear them out.
radio.done: Pressure's up. The ward is breathing. Delta's open.

objectives.label: Throw the main breaker

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The main breaker is at the end of the north-east corridor. Throw it and every light in the building comes on.
radio.done: Power's back! Every light in the building... oh no. Two of them just walked into the atrium.

objectives.label: Put down the Brutes in the atrium

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Two Brutes in the atrium! Keep them off the wards!
radio.done: Both down. Ambulance bay, now.

objectives.label: Out through the ambulance bay

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Ambulance bay, everyone. Forty-five seconds.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 250

notes.title: Night nurse's notes
notes.text: Bed 4 sat up and asked for tea. Bed 4 has had BRIAR for nineteen days. Dr Vey's serum, third dose. The lesions are drying. I have been nursing for thirty years and I sat down in the corridor and laughed.

notes.title: Patient file, sealed
notes.text: Patient zero. Arthur Penn, 61, gardener, Harrow Botanical Gardens. Admitted with lesions after handling a test crop in the Glasshouse. Transferred to Halden custody, project LANTERN, by order of Minister Marlowe. Not to be discussed with Dr Vey.

notes.title: A dog-eared notebook
notes.text: Beacon section, atrium. Lights out at 0200. Something in the walls. If you're the next team: they come from the ducts, not the doors. Keep your backs to the pillars. Tell my sister I said the thing I never said.

name: The Minister
description: Minister Edwin Marlowe signed BRIAR's field trials a year early, and he holds the codes to Halden's sealed lab under the city. He is locked in his safe room. Blow it open and get him out alive. Answers can come later.
briefing: Edwin Marlowe, Minister for Reconstruction, approved BRIAR's field trials a year ahead of Dr Vey's safety tests and ran something called LANTERN behind her back. He is also the only man alive with the codes to Halden's sealed lab under the metro.
He locked himself in the safe room of his house on the hill when the dead came up the drive, and the lock has died with the power. His bodyguards turned in the hall, vests and all.

Put down the guards, blow the safe room door, walk him to the helipad on the lawn and light the pad's four corners for Kestrel. The garden generator wakes the pad's turrets. Nine minutes before the chopper turns back.
debrief: Marlowe is aboard and he gave up the codes before the skids left the grass. He didn't say sorry. Okafor didn't ask him to.

objectives.label: Put down the minister's bodyguards in the house

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Marlowe's bodyguards turned in the hall and they're still wearing their vests: it'll take a lot to put them down. I've marked them. Then we talk about that door.
radio.done: Guards are down. The safe room door won't open from outside.

objectives.label: Blow the safe room door

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: You're going to blow the door? With me in here? Wait! At least let me get behind the desk! Fifteen seconds, you said? Fifteen?
radio.done: I'm alive! I'm alive. Get me out of here.

objectives.label: Walk the minister to the helipad

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: Stay close to me. You don't understand, LANTERN was meant to save people. It was meant to...
radio.done: Is that the chopper? Tell me that's the chopper.

objectives.label: Light the four corners of the pad

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. I can't see the pad in this. The landing lights are on posts at each corner: stand at each one till it comes on. And mind the big one coming over the lawn!
radio.done: I see four lights. Coming round.

objectives.label: Everyone on the chopper

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: On the skids. Thirty seconds!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200

notes.title: A letter on the study desk
notes.text: Sana is right that BRIAR is not ready. She is wrong that it matters. The fields were sprayed; the Treasury has its harvest figures. LANTERN will contain any spread: a serum we can make ourselves, without her. If it fails, Ashgate is small. Ashgate can be burned.

notes.title: Diary, last page
notes.text: Day 7 in the safe room. LANTERN did not work. Penn turned in the lab and they could not stop him. The child, the Pryce child, is the answer. Sana has her. Sana has always had the answer. I gave the codes to no one. I will give them to whoever opens this door.

notes.title: In the gardener's bothy
notes.text: Mr Penn from the Glasshouse came here last spring with cuttings from the trial crop, said the minister wanted them in the rose beds. Roses died. Then the hedges. I bricked myself in when Mr Penn came back. He was walking wrong.

name: Cure
description: Dr Vey has made it: a serum from Mila Pryce's blood, in Halden's sealed lab at the end of the metro. Take Marlowe's codes down through the dark station and carry the cure up before the bombers reach Harrow.
briefing: This is it. Dr Vey went down to Halden's sealed lab under the metro with Marlowe's codes and Mila's blood, and twelve hours later sent one message: it works. Then the lab went silent.

The station has no power. Your weapon lights are all you have, past the ticket hall and down through a stopped train whose tank is leaking gas, to a blast door that opens slowly under the lab's jammer. Your kit will not work there.

Vey is sealed in lab four with the cure; the code for its door is on a bench in one of the other labs. The government has given up on Harrow. Bombers are over the city in eleven minutes. Carry the cure to the pad on the roof yard.
debrief: The cure is on the bird, and so is Dr Vey, who was in lab four with the door barred, holding it. Mila is waiting at the airfield. Behind you, Harrow lights up white. The Rotline is broken. So is the rot.

objectives.label: Take both stairheads at the entrance

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. Dropping you by the stadium. Two stairheads down into the station: take both and hold them till the street gives up.
radio.done: Station doors are open. No going back up after this.

objectives.label: Open the platform gates from the ticket office

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. The platform gates are run from the ticket office, west side of the hall. It's dark down there. Lights on.
radio.done: Gates are up. Down you go.

objectives.label: Through the train ahead of the gas

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: ...gas... the dead train's tank is leaking and it's coming up the platform behind you. Through the carriages and out the far end, quick!
radio.done: You're through and it's settling. Don't go back.

objectives.label: Hold the blast door while it opens

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The blast door runs on Marlowe's codes and it's slow. And the lab's jammer is on: your kit won't work this close. Forty seconds, guns only.
radio.done: It's open. Labs ahead.

objectives.label: Search the labs for the code to lab four

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: ...Lantern? It's Vey. I'm in lab four with the cure and the door is sealed. The override code is on one of the benches in the other labs, I wrote it down, I don't remember which. Please hurry.
radio.done: That's the code. Lab four is open.

objectives.label: Carry the cure to the pad

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The case on the bench. It's all of it. Every dose. Don't drop it, I don't have Mila's blood for another batch.
radio.done: Cure's on the pad.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute on the pad

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: There's something huge on the roof yard, I can't land! Is that... that's Penn. Patient zero.
radio.done: It's down. He's down. Coming in.

objectives.label: Everyone on the bird

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Forty-five seconds, then the bombers are over the city!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200
Optional: burn the nest in the dead train

notes.title: Station announcement script
notes.text: This station is closed by order of the Ministry. Halden Agritech personnel only beyond this point. Passengers are asked to make their way to the surface. (Scrawled across it:) THERE IS NO SURFACE LEFT

notes.title: Staff room noticeboard
notes.text: Lights out at 2300 every night now. Halden says the trains carry "seed stock" to the lab at the end of the line. We've stopped asking. Kettle's broken. Somebody bricked the door from the outside. Not funny, Gary.

notes.title: Lab journal, last entry
notes.text: Batch complete. Mila's antibodies bind BRIAR's coat protein and the whole thing falls apart, like pulling one thread out of a jumper. I made this. I unmade it. If you are reading this and I am not here, take the case. Tell Mila she saved everyone. Tell her she can have the crisps.

description: Three minutes in the old food depot with the nests awake. Kill as many as you can, as fast as you can.
briefing: The food depot is boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.

radio.start: Three minutes. Make them count.

name: Supply Run
description: Three supply crates are lying around an overrun army compound. Carry each one back to the truck in the courtyard.
briefing: An army compound outside Harrow was overrun with its stores still in it. Three crates are worth the trip.
Carry them to the truck in the courtyard. Carrying slows you down: travel light.
debrief: Crates are on the truck. Good haul.

name: Data Grab
description: Four terminals in an overrun army compound still hold their data. Pull it from every one, then get to the truck.
briefing: The compound's terminals still have the army's patrol data on them. Pull it from all four: HQ, operations, the radar hut and the vehicle shed.

radio.start: Four terminals. Work them in any order.

radio.start: Two and a half minutes out. Don't let them tear it open!
radio.done: Convoy's here. Shipment's safe.
